title: lolium rigidum var. maritimum
intro: Lolium rigidum var. maritimum, commonly known as annual ryegrass, is a coastal weed species native to Australia and New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Lolium rigidum var. maritimum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
